answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The karst multiplier is published, charged in wander, and crystal lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4658 identities would post 3570 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
